motivation: File content fsync alone did not request persistence of the newly published directory entry.
change: Sync containing directory after publication; preserve identity and report uncertain durability on sync failure.
tests: Two new tests failed on the old implementation; all 50 offline tests pass after modification.
audit: 29 reachable commits and 79 distinct blobs scanned after code commit, no rule matches. Not proof of absence of all secrets.
limitations: Synthetic faults do not prove real crash survival. Newly created ancestor directories are not individually synced. No upstream adoption claimed.
verification: HTTP 200 and stored signature verified. Exact nonce is retained in signed_receipt; signature covers room|nonce|text, not server sequence or timestamp.
